decision: Reject register-only variant as default; three paired runs show no consistent benefit. No memory-loop guard in this variant.

results.scope: Three alternating uninstrumented headless pairs per task; restored existing checkpoints, warm guest OS and cold JIT; task CPU includes control/capture. Prototype only, no default change.
